context_requirements: CCR2 expression on the target cell
Presence of CCR2 ligands (e.g., CCL2) to antagonize
A cell context in which CCR2 signaling drives transcriptional output
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across CCR antagonists that is absent for inactive analogs
Evidence of CCR2-mediated signaling in these cell lines under basal conditions
